    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "The trigger says the whole summary – \"Background tasks: 3 running, 2 need you\" – and has aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls"
      - listitem: The list is a dialog named "Background tasks"; a click outside or tabbing out of it closes it
      - listitem: Each row is a button that reads its title, state, step and steps – "Ingest pipeline – running. Embedding chunks. 2 of 4 steps"
      - listitem: Every icon button names its task – "Pause Ingest pipeline", "Open Refund review – needs you"
      - listitem: A polite live region says when a task starts waiting for you or finishes
      - listitem: "Focus never drops to the page: Pause and Resume keep it on the same button, and when a task finishes (or leaves the list) it moves to that row or the nearest one"
      - listitem: Focus rings show for the keyboard only (:focus-visible), in light and dark
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The ring fills like a pie as the steps go by, and changes color with it – orange, amber, teal, blue once done
      - listitem: "A new step crossfades in place: the old line slides up and out while the new one rises in; the counts in the trigger do the same"
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything changes at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every row is 52px in every state – a step that changes, a badge that comes or goes never moves another row
      - listitem: The popover is 340px wide and never wider than the screen minus 32px, so it fits a 375px phone
      - listitem: Touch screens get 36px buttons, a 36px trigger and 56px rows
      - listitem: The list scrolls inside the popover after five and a half rows – the half row shows there is more – and stays clear of short screens
      - listitem: On a phone narrower than 360px, or with four-digit counts below 420px, the trigger keeps only the numbers when both counts show; its label still reads the full summary
      - listitem: "Right-to-left: the popover lines up with the logical edge, titles and steps follow their own direction"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Give every task a stable id – the crossfade and the live region track rows by it
      - listitem: Keep step short and in the present – "Embedding chunks", not "The agent is currently embedding chunks"; for needs-you, write what it waits for
      - listitem: done and total are steps; with total 0 the ring stays empty
      - listitem: Paused tasks don't count as running in the trigger
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-rnc, e.g. --ui-rnc-teal or --ui-rnc-amber; the popover width is --ui-rnc-w
